mapper.select: SELECT id,batch_id,task_id,shop_number,event_type,status,retry_at,attempts,worker_id,lease_until,last_error,create_time,update_time FROM t_coupon_task_batch_outbox WHERE status='NEW' OR (status='RETRY' AND retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',worker_id=#{workerId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_number=#{shopNumber} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch_outbox SET status='DONE',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_number=#{shopNumber} AND status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch_outbox SET status='RETRY',retry_at=#{retryAt},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_number=#{shopNumber} AND status='PUBLISHED'
UPDATE t_coupon_task_batch_outbox SET retry_at=#{nextCheckAt},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND shop_number=#{shopNumber} AND status='PUBLISHED'
